speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.ranked: Race TascadeBot if no one in the ranked queue for longer than a minute. Does not affect your elo.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.matchS: Play a sound when an opponent is found, when a vote starts, passes or expires, when the seed changes, and for the match result.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.cheats: Create runs with cheats on. Runs played with cheats don't affect your elo or pp. In ranked queue you're matched up against a player who has cheats on too.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.discor: Show what you're doing in Tascade on your Discord profile. Needs Discord app running.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.raceHu: The leaderboard at the side of the screen during a run: showing live splits and who's ahead.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.oppone: Chat with your ranked opponent. Off: their messages aren't shown and yours aren't sent. Match notices, like votes, and their advancements still show.
Show your ranked opponent's advancements in chat.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.hideRo: Show custom room code as asterisks. Copy Code still copies the real code.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.rememb: Keep the run modifiers you picked after closing the game.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.pauseM: Seconds the run buttons stay disabled each time you open the pause menu. (Forfeit Match, Exit Run, Reset World, and the votes) 0 turns it off.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.replay: Keep the replay of a solo run you complete.
Keep the replay of a solo run you left before finishing it.
Keep the replay of a solo world you seed-changed.
Keep the replay of a ranked match you won, by finishing first or because your opponent forfeited.
Keep the replay of a ranked match you lost (excluding forfeits).
Keep the replay of a ranked match that ended with a draw.
Keep the replay of a ranked match you forfeited, or left by closing the game.
Keep the replay of a ranked world you and your opponent voted to change the seed
The fastest playback speed a replay plays sounds at. Cap if you don't like how it sounds or having audio issues at high speeds.
